about.title: Dance in the air
paragraphs: This project was born a few months ago, dreaming together with friends about trying new aerial experiences.
About the chance to fly and play with heights...
About creating a space for creativity and bringing in new apparatus we are passionate about.
With a lot of effort, planning and the motivation of my friends, who are always there imagining new possibilities, AERIAL EXPERIENCE was born.
So that you can feel free to express yourselves. We want AERIAL EXPERIENCE to be a refuge for free expression, where each person can discover their own way of flying and feel completely free.
I am deeply grateful to everyone who has supported us on this exciting journey, and I invite you to join us in October to enjoy together this experience we have built with love.
about.closing: I can't wait to fly high and explore new apparatus with you!

disciplines.title: Choose your apparatus
disciplines.straps: Two suspended straps that challenge your strength, control and precision. We work on pulls, rotations and dynamic figures, building a solid shoulder and core foundation step by step.
disciplines.trapeze: Dance trapeze brings flight and choreographic movement together. Swings, spins and flowing transitions on the bar and ropes, where technique becomes expression.
disciplines.hammock: A fabric hammock that holds you and invites you to explore. Ideal for beginners: inversions, wraps and gentle drops, combining strength, flexibility and plenty of confidence.
